G1-PAIRED-GRAMMAR.changed_hypothesis: Scalar input/output shears and compensation/cleanup may change. This is not the already-covered fixed-gate dirty-entry/frame screen of PR2904. It applies the credited paired production from PR2908/PR2917 to the later final state, without a novelty claim for the mechanism.
controls: Unchanged final baseline all-column semantic/profile check.
Known predecessor extraction as a positive production control using pinned transform data.
Wrong shear sign or omitted compensation must fail the exact identity.
Corrupted terminal frame and uncharged extra buffer must fail their respective admission gates.

domain.excluded: Rank-7 helper408, an active external lead.
domain.hyperplanes: All 511 rank-8 hyperplanes in the 9-dimensional binary frame space.
modes: exact minimal-frame eligibility then maximal legal downward frame-cap propagation on synthesized output support only
domain.pair_order: The eight sparsest nonzero pairs drawn from canonical exact rational nullspace bases; deterministic canonical tie order recorded by implementation.
domain.pivot_order: At most sixteen eligible helper pivots in deterministic canonical order; exact tie convention frozen in implementation before run.
domain.truncation: Record total basis-pair and eligible-pivot counts and all truncation. No all-combinations or saturation conclusion.

G1-PAIRED-GRAMMAR.incomplete: Missing algebraic coverage, timeouts, failed baseline controls or unresolved semantic/physical obligations yield EXPLORATORY/ERROR/TIMEOUT, not scientific NULL.
invariants: Entrances, removed helpers, correction-source identities, centre/cut/warp interfaces preserved.
Exact formal operator equations alpha*M=u and M*v=y on distinct free warp words, C*v=0, alpha*y=1.
Synthesize only dyadic input/output shears and rederive full compensation C*S and literal cleanup.
Both provider variants, forward and dual, all independent dirty input columns must pass.
Fresh canonical profile and helper inventory, all additional buffers and native/physical costs explicitly charged.
G1-PAIRED-GRAMMAR.null_bar: The entire registered bounded basis/pivot protocol completes without a candidate meeting its bar. Any NULL is limited to these exact bases, pair/pivot caps and frame modes, not all paired directions.
G1-PAIRED-GRAMMAR.pass_bar: At least one emitted concrete candidate whose exact production and both-provider full semantic/frame checks pass and whose completed local-plus-idle profile improves the pinned source under an explicit admissible allocation; native/supplier/outer acceptance remains a separate mandatory gate for the user goal.
G1-PAIRED-GRAMMAR.question: Does another exact paired input/output extraction on the final 82-endpoint PR2917 word yield a fully charged admissible gain?
G1-PAIRED-GRAMMAR.recording: Immutable RESULT per seed, candidate word/production data and hashes, complete ledgers, covered/truncated counts, source archives, checkpoints and memory projection.
G1-PAIRED-GRAMMAR.second_seed: Two distinct traversal seeds must independently confirm any positive/negative decision. Candidate identity and all exact output checks must be compared.
